title: Broad usage reset reported around the eight-million-user milestone
summary: Two independent public Codex issues described an unbanked usage reset around July 14. One report called it a global reset associated with the eight-million-user milestone; another observed weekly usage returning to full while banked reset credits did not change. No canonical OpenAI announcement or staff confirmation was located, so the event and promotional attribution remain lower-confidence inferred history.

cause.rationale: One independent report associated the reset with an eight-million-user milestone, but no approved official source was located to confirm either the motivation or universal scope.

detectionSignals: Independent accounts report weekly usage returning to full on the same date.
The active usage window restarts while banked reset-credit balances remain unchanged.
A permanent official announcement or staff statement would raise confidence in the milestone attribution.
contradictions: The reports disagree implicitly about whether the reset was universal because at least one account reported missing it.
The distinction between a hard reset and a banked reset reward was not consistently communicated.
No source-native official announcement was located in the configured sources.
